items.title: MXP London Startup Hackathon & Masterclass: Build Prototypes and Master Product Strategy in One Day (May 19)
items.summary: 🇬🇧 If you're based in London, this one's for you! MXP London: Startup Hackathon & Masterclass 📅 Tuesday, 19 May |📍Mixpanel London HQ, The Dock @ TIDE Bankside | 🆓 Free to attend We're hosting a one-day, product experience in partnership with ProductX and Replit, and there are still a handful of spots left. This isn't your typical hackathon. You'll go from strategy to working prototype in a single day, all built around one question: how do you make better product decisions when AI has changed how fast everyone can build? Here's how the day breaks down 👇 🧠 Morning masterclass with ProductX: a live session on Product Strategy in the AI Era. Why traditional prioritization frameworks are breaking down, and what a sharper decision-making framework actually looks like in practice. 💡 Hackathon sessions: work in small teams to define a problem, design a solution, and build a working prototype. The challenge prompt is revealed on the day, so no idea or team needed beforehand! 🔍 Expert product analysis: after presentations, a panel of experts will breakdown each team's solution, connecting the product choices back to real business outcomes. The stakes 🏆 • Winning team is announced during the MXP London main conference keynote on 21 May and takes home a cash prize • Every participant gets a free month of Replit Core Spots are limited to keep it tight and collaborative. If you're a founder, PM, or growth lead in London, come spend a Tuesday with us. 👉 Apply here: https://events.mixpanel.com/hackathon-london-2026/

items.title: 👋 Hey everyone! The Mixpanel EMEA marketing team have been sitting on some data that's too good not to share with this...
items.summary: 👋 Hey everyone! The Mixpanel EMEA marketing team have been sitting on some data that's too good not to share with this community. We just wrapped up one of our biggest research projects to date, analysing 423 billion user events across global ecommerce operations. The EMEA findings are turning heads and we think every ecommerce leader in this group should see them. Here's everything we've put together, and why it's worth your time: 📊 The 2026 State of Digital Analytics Report We benchmarked ecommerce performance across 8 industries and 4 global regions. EMEA's numbers tell a story that goes deeper than market conditions. • Engagement down 48% YoY • Actions per user is the lowest globally. • Weekly retention nearly 20 points behind APAC The report breaks down exactly what's driving it, what high-performing teams are doing differently, and the metrics that move the needle on acquisition, engagement, stickiness, and retention. → Download the report (https://mixpanel.com/content/benchmarks-2026?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=slack-soda-report). ✍️ What 423 billion events told us about EMEA ecommerce growth If you want the "so what" without diving through the full dataset first, start here. This analysis unpacks the single biggest shift happening across ecommerce right now. The blog covers everything from chasing acquisition volume to building genuine user habits and why EMEA teams are feeling it most. It also explains the difference between metrics that predict durable growth and the vanity metrics that create noise. A quick read that reframes how you think about measurement. Read the blog (https://mixpanel.com/blog/ecommerce-benchmarks-2026/?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=slack-soda-blog). (https://mixpanel.com/blog/ecommerce-benchmarks-2026/?utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-state-of-digital-analytics-emea-ecommerce-campaign&utm_content=2026-state-of-digital-analytics-b2b-blog) ✅ The 2026 EMEA Ecommerce Opportunity: Blind Spot Diagnostic This one's our favorite. It's a one-page checklist built directly from the report findings. Focusing on four areas where EMEA teams are consistently losing visibility without realising it: localisation gaps, measurement failures, retention unknowns, and missed opportunities. It takes about 60 seconds to complete. Most teams find at least one blind spot they weren't expecting. And the good news is, every single one is fixable. → Download the diagnostic checklist (https://userimg-assets.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-141894/1774440511797_SODA_Ecommerce%20Lead%20magnet_One%20pager_01KMJEAYFN43PSR72731PC3MV0.pdf). As always, happy to answer any questions in the thread and would love to hear what resonates with your team. Best, The EMEA Marketing Team

items.title: Mixpanel MCP: Use AI Tools to Analyze Product Data with Natural Language Queries and Reports
items.summary: 💬 Mixpanel MCP: Talk to Your Data @here Mixpanel MCP brings your product data into the AI tools you already use - Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, Notion, and more. Ask questions in natural language, get answers backed by real data, and take action without switching context. Connect your first AI tool → (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/mcp) What you can do Build boards and reports in natural language. Ask a question, get an answer — and a Mixpanel report to go with it. • Combine behavioral data with qualitative context in a single conversation. Pull up a specific user’s replays alongside their event history to understand not just what they did, but how they experienced it. • Project Owners and Admins can manage event and property metadata directly through MCP — generating descriptions, verifying data, tagging events, and hiding or dropping properties at scale. Try these prompts • “In the last three months, which channels have driven the most new users?” • “User X submitted negative feedback on [date]. Analyze their session replays to understand what happened.” • “Show me signup conversion rates by acquisition source for the last 30 days.” • “Generate event descriptions for all of my events in Lexicon.” Learn more about Mixpanel MCP → (https://mixpanel.com/blog/mixpanel-mcp/)

items.title: Introducing AI Metric Trees: Automate Your Growth Strategy with AI-Powered Metric Mapping
items.summary: 🌳 Introducing AI Metric Trees (https://docs.mixpanel.com/changelogs/2026-03-12-metric-trees-ai)! 🌳 Quick refresher: Metric Trees map *how your business actually grows*, connecting your north star to the bets, drivers, and inputs that move it. If you're not using one yet, it's one of the best ways to align your team around what actually matters. Now there's an even faster way to get started. Just enter your company URL and a little context and you'll get a full structured draft in seconds. North star, strategic bets, drivers, input metrics, all laid out. The part we're especially excited about: it surfaces metrics and drivers you might not have thought of, based on your growth model and industry best practices. It's like a second brain for your strategy doc. From there, make it yours. Edit the structure and connect nodes to your real Mixpanel data. ✨ → Learn more (https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/metric_tree#option-build-with-ai) Metric Trees are available as an add-on for Enterprise plan customers. AI Metric Trees doesn't use your Mixpanel data and is powered by OpenAI and industry best practices.

items.title: Hands-On Workshop in Singapore on Advanced Product Analytics with Mixpanel – March 3rd
items.summary: 🇸🇬 Calling all users based in Singapore! We're running a hands-on workshops on 3 Mar as part of our Data & Donuts user event series! Seats are limited so sign up (https://events.mixpanel.com/data-and-donuts-singapore-mar26/) asap to secure your space. Detailed agenda below 👇 Hands-on Workshop: Building Ground Truth for PMs 3 Mar, 9am - 12pm, WeWork Mapletree Anson This workshop is designed for product and analytics teams who want to move beyond basic dashboards and learn how to analyze real user behavior using Mixpanel’s advanced capabilities. Using an AI-powered product as a sample dataset, we’ll explore how modern product teams answer critical questions around activation, engagement, retention, and growth—without relying on industry-specific assumptions. The AI use case provides a familiar, flexible context that makes it easy to translate insights to any digital product. Participants will learn how to: • Identify where users drop off in complex, multi-step funnels • Understand real user journeys with flows and path analysis • Measure meaningful retention based on user actions, not just logins • Discover which behaviours drive long-term value and monetisation • Segment users by behaviour, not just demographics or plans This session is ideal for teams looking to level up their product analytics practice and apply Mixpanel insights to real-world product decisions—whether they’re working on consumer apps, SaaS, or emerging AI products.

items.title: Calculate Sample Size for Successful A/B Testing Efforts
items.summary: Find the Sweet Spot for Your A/B Tests! | @here Planning an experiment? Our free Sample Size Calculator helps you figure out exactly how much traffic you need to get reliable, statistically significant results — so you can make confident, data-driven decisions. With it, you can: • 🎯 Enter your baseline conversion rate and minimum detectable effect • ⚙️ Adjust your confidence level, power, and number of variants • 📊 Instantly see your total and per-variant sample size No more guesswork — just clear, actionable guidance for better experimentation. Try it free here: 👉 mixpanel.com/platform/experiments/sample-size-calculator (http://mixpanel.com/platform/experiments/sample-size-calculator)
